en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The free would not be killed due to the slave. And when the free one kills the slave, he would be fined his value, and would be whipped with intense whipping’.
